content.text:
Investigation complete and sent to the parent agent.

Core finding: Jev never controls the game directly. One Python process runs PyBoy, decodes RAM, deterministically identifies whether a real choice exists, sends only a compact legal-choice payload to Jev, validates its answer, translates it into button presses, and advances the emulator again.

The key missing layers beyond the original model are goals/route control, input readiness, screen/menu detection, legal-action construction, fallback/error handling, battle turn settlement, and decision logging/replay.
